title: Transfer | Volcano Tremor Coverage Audit
goal: Load a day of continuous volcano monitoring waveforms plus station metadata, merge fragmented traces into per-station streams, compute hourly coverage and the first missing interval for each station, and emit `/root/volcano_gap_report.json` for observatory handoff.
skillBenefitRationale: The hard part is using ObsPy’s waveform containers and header/time abstractions to merge, inspect, and summarize fragmented continuous records with correct station context. No additional shipped skill is required.
